name: app-shell
title: AppShell
description: Page frame: skip link, top bar (banner), main navigation, and main content. The navigation collapses behind a disclosure button below 768px.

keyboard: First stop is the skip link; it becomes visible on focus
Moves focus to <main> (works with hash routers too)
Opens or closes the navigation below 768px
Closes the open navigation below 768px and returns focus to the Menu button
aria: The active nav link has aria-current="page"
The Menu button has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the nav
Below 768px the closed nav is display:none, so it is out of the tab order and the accessibility tree
The nav is closed after a link is chosen
banner prop is a site-wide notice rendered below the top bar, not a landmark
a11y.notes: Render exactly one h1 per page inside children. Pass renderLink to use router links; spread the props it receives onto your link element.
